id: 21_ELCB Vs RCCB Difference between ELCB and RCCB @HSE STUDY GUIDE
title: ELCB与RCCB的区别
source_doc: course/Electrical Safety Series/21_ELCB Vs RCCB Difference between ELCB and RCCB @HSE STUDY GUIDE.md
author_source: project/Electrical Safety Series/21_ELCB Vs RCCB Difference between ELCB and RCCB @HSE STUDY GUIDE/src.py

shots.scene: 欣欣站在两个外观相似的空白模块中间
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between two similar blank breaker modules mounted on a rail and waves at the camera.
overlay: 两种漏电保护器：十个方面比一比

shots.scene: 左边模块下有电压表图标，右边模块下有电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: Two blank breaker modules, a voltmeter icon under the left one and an ammeter icon under the right one. No people.

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰站在一栋旧楼的配电箱前
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student stand in front of an old distribution box in a building corridor.
shots.narration: 老周带阿杰巡查楼里的配电箱。

shots.scene: 旧配电箱里一个泛黄的老式模块
shots.prompt_en: Inside the box, an old yellowed breaker module sits next to newer white modules. No people.
shots.narration: 这里还装着一个老式的ELCB。

shots.scene: 阿杰指着两个模块，一脸疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student points at the old and new modules with a puzzled face.
shots.narration: 阿杰问：它们有什么不一样？

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一叠扇形展开的空白卡片
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a stack of ten blank cards fanned out.
shots.narration: 我们从十个方面来比较。

shots.scene: 十张空白卡片排成两列
shots.prompt_en: Ten blank cards arranged in two columns on a board, each with a small number circle. No people.
shots.narration: 两者的区别，可以归纳成十点。

shots.scene: 另外五张卡片亮起
shots.prompt_en: The second column of five cards lights up one by one. No people.

shots.scene: 老式模块连着设备外壳的接地线，旁边电压表
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: an old blank breaker module with a sensing wire to the ground wire of a metal instrument case, a voltmeter icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB看接地线和电源间的电压差。

shots.scene: 电压表指针偏转，模块跳闸
shots.prompt_en: The voltmeter needle swings and the old module's lever drops to off. No people.

shots.scene: 新模块圆环中穿过两根线，进出箭头
shots.prompt_en: A new blank breaker module with a ring core, a red wire and a black wire passing through with opposite arrows. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB比较相线和中性线的电流。

shots.scene: 两根线的箭头长短不一，模块跳闸
shots.prompt_en: The arrows on the two wires become unequal and the new module trips to off. No people.

shots.scene: 左边模块旁一个小耳朵图标，右边模块旁一个大耳朵图标
shots.prompt_en: A small ear icon beside the old module and a large ear icon beside the new module. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB靠电压检测，灵敏度较低。

shots.scene: 放大镜直接对准漏电的小箭头
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass focused directly on a tiny leaking current arrow next to the new module. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB直接测漏电流，更灵敏可靠。

shots.scene: 老式模块只盯着一根接地线
shots.prompt_en: The old module with a single spotlight on one ground wire only. No people.

shots.scene: 新模块对多条入地路径都亮起
shots.prompt_en: The new module glows as leakage arrows go to ground through several paths: a body pictogram, a wet floor and a pipe. No people.

shots.scene: 相线与中性线之间的漏电箭头，新模块亮起跳闸
shots.prompt_en: A leakage arrow between the live and neutral wires, and the new module glows and trips. No people.
shots.narration: 还防相线到中性线的漏电故障。

shots.scene: 老式模块的接地线断开，模块打问号
shots.prompt_en: The ground wire of the old module is broken and the module shows a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB必须有良好接地才能工作。

shots.scene: 断开的接地线，红叉
shots.prompt_en: The broken ground wire is crossed out with a red X and the old module stays dark. No people.

shots.scene: 新模块只看圆环里的两根线，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The new module watches only the two wires through its ring, green check. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB不依赖接地连接就能动作，

shots.scene: 多种建筑和设备图标旁，新模块都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Several building and machine icons, each with the new module and a green check. No people.

shots.scene: 左边一只蜗牛图标，右边一只兔子图标
shots.prompt_en: A snail icon beside the old module and a rabbit icon beside the new module. No people.

shots.scene: 电流箭头一出现，新模块立即跳下
shots.prompt_en: As soon as a leakage arrow appears, the new module flips off instantly with a small flash. No people.

shots.scene: 老式模块放进标着旧时钟的盒子
shots.prompt_en: The old module is placed into a box marked with an old clock icon. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB是老技术，现代装置很少用。

shots.scene: 新建大楼的配电箱里一排新模块
shots.prompt_en: A modern distribution box in a new building with a row of new blank breaker modules. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB广泛用于现代电气系统。

shots.scene: 接地不良的老房子图标旁，老式模块打问号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an old building with a poor ground connection next to the old module with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 接地不好的系统，ELCB不一定适用。

shots.scene: 多种建筑图标旁，新模块都打勾
shots.prompt_en: Several building icons, each with the new module and a green check. No people.

shots.scene: 老式模块旁的盾牌有裂缝
shots.prompt_en: A cracked shield icon beside the old module and a broken ground wire. No people.

shots.scene: 新模块旁的盾牌完整
shots.prompt_en: A solid shield icon beside the new module. No people.
shots.narration: RCCB不依赖接地，更安全可靠。

shots.scene: 老式模块旁一枚硬币，新模块旁两枚硬币
shots.prompt_en: One coin icon beside the old module and two coin icons beside the new module. No people.

shots.scene: 新模块旁的盾牌和硬币，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The new module with two coins and a shield, green check. No people.

shots.scene: 老式模块挂上淘汰标签，渐渐变灰
shots.prompt_en: The old module gets a blank outdated tag and fades to gray. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB局限多，许多地区已淘汰。

shots.scene: 新模块装上导轨，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A new blank breaker module clicks onto the mounting rail with a green check. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现两个模块图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two floating blank breaker module icons.

shots.scene: 新模块旁的放大镜、兔子、盾牌图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a magnifying glass, a rabbit and a shield beside the new module. No people.

shots.scene: 断开的接地线旁老式模块变灰
shots.prompt_en: A broken ground wire beside the old module, which fades to gray. No people.
shots.narration: ELCB离不开接地，RCCB不依赖接地。

shots.scene: 硬币和淘汰标签图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of coins and a blank outdated tag beside the old module. No people.

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好门的配电箱旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a closed distribution box.
